Monique H. Clinical Research What the Conference and Events Coordinator does at Worldwide The Conference and Events Coordinator is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of global conferences and events in alignment with Worldwide’s marketing and business objectives. This role focuses on operational excellence, logistical coordination, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure seamless event execution before, during, and after conferences. The Conference and Events Coordinator partners with Conference Leads, Marketing, Sales Development, and Therapeutic Area teams to deliver high-quality events that support client engagement, brand presence, and commercial outcomes. What you will do Coordinate logistics for conferences and events, including registrations, hotel reservations, exhibition space logistics, materials management, giveaways, transport, and occasional onsite support. Support planning and execution of client events held in conjunction with conferences. Assist with scheduling and coordination of conference planning meetings, interim check-ins, and post-event debrief sessions. Maintain conference coordination checklists, timelines, and task trackers to ensure accurate and timely delivery of event activities. Support setup and management of event collaboration spaces (e.g., Microsoft Teams channels). Coordinate exhibition and event materials, including booth assets, furniture, signage, roll-ups, and related logistics. What you will bring to the role Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured processes, templates, and checklists. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders. Your experience Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field . Minimum 2 years of experience coordinating events, conferences, or large meetings in a corporate, agency, or professional services environment, with healthcare/life sciences preferred. paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Conference and Event Coordinator position at Worldwide Clinical Trials. With my background in coordinating international events, managing logistics, and collaborating across teams, I am confident that I can contribute to planning and executing successful conferences that align with your marketing and business objectives.

Throughout my career, I have honed my event coordination skills by organizing community events for International House Oulu, managing logistics and registrations for conferences at Juris Nexus in India, and supporting legal firm events during my language placement at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy. My experience aligns well with the key requirements of this role, and I am eager to apply my skills to support Worldwide Clinical Trials' global conference needs.

In addition to my event coordination experience, I have a strong academic foundation in law, having earned an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank) from Symbiosis International University. I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland, which reflects my commitment to integrating my international expertise with local legal systems.

I am particularly drawn to Worldwide Clinical Trials' mission and global presence. The opportunity to contribute to your conference and event planning team would be a valuable next step in my career. I am available to start in September 2026 and look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills can support your organization's goals.
Thank you for considering my application. I hope to have the chance to further discuss my qualifications and potential contributions to Worldwide Clinical Trials.
